address: 152-2 Haizhu South Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Nestled in an old neighbourhood, this shop has kept regulars coming back for almost three decades with their no-frills, tasty food at frugal prices. Come early for their double-boiled soups which tend to run out early. Fish head soup particularly entices with succulent flesh and a hint of Chinese herbs; brace yourself for the heady aromas when you lift the paper lid. Steamed chicken, roast goose and steamed pork patties are also popular choices....
